description:
Runs an instant live HTTP/ping probe test against any website or API URL.

Measures exact response time (latency), HTTP status code, response headers, and response snippet without creating a monitor.

Use this tool to verify endpoint reachability, test latency, check SSL/TLS responses, or diagnose an ongoing outage.

body.description: Optional request body payload for POST/PUT/PATCH.

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, HEAD, PUT, OPTIONS).

target.description: Target URL or IP address to test (e.g. https://api.example.com/health).

name: test_endpoint
